name: crisisgrid
description: Local-first disaster response and emergency resource coordination prototype.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@crisisgrid/api && npm run build --workspace=@crisisgrid/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@crisisgrid/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@crisisgrid/web && tsc -p database/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@crisisgrid/api && npm run test --workspace=@crisisgrid/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@crisisgrid/api && npm run lint --workspace=@crisisgrid/web
